item.title: From prototype to production: Engineering agents with Agent DLC
item.description: Agents stall between demo and release when teams lack a repeatable way to measure how good an agent is and whether the last change helped. item.title: Semantic diffing of formal policies with anti-unification
item.description: A textual diff of two formal policies flags every cosmetic change and hides the one that alters behavior. This post shows how to compute a symbolic, deterministic semantic diff with an open-source anti-unification engine, so reviewers see only the genuine disagreements between two candidate authorization policies. — 来源：techcrunch_ai · aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/semantic-diffing-of-formal-policies-with-anti-unification/

item.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement. — 来源：hackernews · aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/detecting-and-recovering-from-silent-data-corruption-on-amazon-sagemaker-hyperpod/
